training_config.calibration: Separate historical week before the decision gap; test labels are never used to calibrate their own intervals
training_config.mase_scale: Product-level one-step naive MAE estimated from base-fit training labels only; zero-scale observations excluded and counted
training_config.universe_selection: Repeated inside each fold from base-fit rows only
training_config.tuning: No search: one fixed preregistered configuration, identical across folds
training_config.interval_limitation: Temporal and cross-product dependence violate exact exchangeability; held-out empirical coverage is the promotion criterion
